BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The attack is delivered over the network through cross-origin HTTP requests.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Any origin the attacker controls, or the easily obtained null origin, is accepted.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The attacker needs no account on the application.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: A logged-in victim must visit a page controlled by the attacker.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The exposed data belongs to the same application.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: The attacker's page can read authenticated responses, including the victim's private data.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: The attacker's page can send authenticated requests that make limited changes as the victim.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: There is no direct impact on availability.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
